title: Places, Not Faces
tagline: Travel & street art from 64 countries and counting
tagline_es: Viajes y arte urbano de 64 países y contando
description: Leiser's travel blog: street art, hidden spots and practical guides from 64 countries, with the tours, eSIMs and deals I actually use.
description_es: El blog de viajes de Leiser: arte urbano, lugares escondidos y guías prácticas de 64 países, con los tours, eSIMs y descuentos que realmente uso.

analytics._help: Cloudflare Web Analytics token (Cloudflare dashboard > Analytics & Logs > Web Analytics > your site > Manage site > the token in the JS snippet). Leave empty if the site uses automatic setup.

googleAds._help: Google Ads conversion for clicks on booking links (Goals > Conversions > Booking click > Tag setup > event snippet: the 'send_to' value). Needs the Google tag in travelpayouts.driveScript. Leave empty to turn off.

pinterest._help: Paste the content value of Pinterest's <meta name="p:domain_verify"> tag here to claim the site (or verify with a DNS TXT record in Cloudflare instead).

_startHere_help: Guides shown at the top of the home page (post slugs, in order). Visitors from the Instagram bio land on the home page, so these are their first click.

youtube._help: YouTube channel handle (without @). Stories can embed a video with 'youtube: <video id>' in their front matter.

travelpayouts._help: From https://app.travelpayouts.com — 'marker' is your partner ID (shown in your profile / in every tp.media link as marker=...). 'trs' is your project ID. Program IDs ('p' values) come from Tools > Links for each program you have joined. Programs left empty link directly (no tracking) unless you paste the Drive script.
